notes.title: 🎉 2-Year Anniversary Celebration! 🐸
notes.content:

notes.title: 🌿✨ Paradise Marsh Soundtrack Now Available! ✨🌿
notes.content:
[h1]🎵 About the Soundtrack[/h1]
I'm thrilled to announce the long-awaited release of the official Paradise Marsh OST on Steam!  Embark on an auditory journey through the serene and mystical landscapes of the game across [b]2 albums [/b](2.5h) of HQ ambient music created by [i][url=http://disasterpeace.com/][b]Disasterpeace[/b][/url][/i] !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/528373cfdcaeb6dde893ebf28e254f46049e3787.png[/img]

[h1]💿 Album 1[/h1]
Already released on streaming platforms, the album [b]"Paradise Marsh"[/b] features various ditties, key moments, trailers music and procedural experiments made during the game's development.

[h1]📀 Album 2[/h1]
Exclusively available on Steam for now, [b][i]Standstill[/i][/b] is a collection of soothing procedural musical ambiances set in diverse environnements of the game. Enjoy it before its official release on streaming platforms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/d8a6c1de6d3781b26017dd212d577d9cf0c08cc4.png[/img]


[h1]🎧 Cool Collaboration Soon! [/h1]

Get ready for a special collaboration with fellow creator [url=https://www.youtube.com/@pwnisher][b]Clinton Jones / @pwnisher[/b][/url] to celebrate the release of [b][i]Standstill[/i][/b] ! You might know him from the wildly popular 3D challenges hosted on his chanel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/81aa262832f1e9028467a9b9c969f8710407dca5.png[/img]

Be sure to tune in on [b]April 12th[/b] for a special surprise on his [url=https://www.youtube.com/@pwnisher][b]YouTube chanel[/b][/url] where we'll celebrate the artistry of Disasterpeace and the enchanting world of Paradise Marsh!


[h1] 💸 Get it While it's CHEAP [/h1]
To celebrate this event, [b]Paradise Marsh is 55 % OFF [/b]   its biggest sale yet!
The sale will be up for a few days, perfect time to get it if you haven't already!



Thanks for your support and catch you on the flip side ; )
[b][url=https://twitter.com/LazyEti]-Eti[/url][/b]

notes.title: Paradise Marsh - Lost Souls Update !
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=z65wH2Nxt3g;full][/previewyoutube]

After months of wait, the Lost Soul Update is finally here !

Discover a mysterious new side quest that features new items, achievements and characters to meet! Whether you engage with these new features or not is your choice since they wont impact the main story but they're sure to bring even more depth and fun to Paradise Marsh!


[h1][b]New Characters[/b][/h1]

Look out for some new colorful characters around the marsh, each with their own stories and personalities. In return for a little help, they'll give you useful tools!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/f19924a91e7245416bcbe14a87c81670bb54cada.gif[/img]

[h1][b]New achievements![/b][/h1]

7 New achievements to unlock ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/6e4f46936aae00ae43e9fb548f05da77a8e9b53c.png[/img]


[h1][b] Francais,  Español,  Italiano![/b][/h1]

Language support so more people can enjoy the game!

The Lost Soul Update is the ultimate way to play Paradise Marsh.

notes.title: Paradise Marsh - Upcoming Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/a2f00dea2051fd66e2f3336ae5e49c4221fa889f.png[/img]

[h1]Paradise Marsh, is preparing for its next big content update![/h1]
Discover a side story that will feature new tools, environnements, achievements and characters to meet! Whether you engage with these new features or not is your choice since they wont impact the main game but they're sure to bring even more depth and fun to Paradise Marsh!

[h3]New Characters[/h3]
Look forward to encounter new colorful characters in the marsh, each with their own stories and personalities! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/a05abf9f48e1b3ef0361c79dc1d24c72caf109af.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/a05abf9f48e1b3ef0361c79dc1d24c72caf109af.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]New Items[/h3]
The update will introduce new items that you can pick up and use throughout the game. These tools will add new layers of interactivity and fun to an already very lively world.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/f19924a91e7245416bcbe14a87c81670bb54cada.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/f19924a91e7245416bcbe14a87c81670bb54cada.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Environnements[/h3]
Speaking of world, the upcoming update will also introduce more variations to the existing environnements as well as new biomes!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/13115c4c5fd7fbc58a0001d73646ee5a08f0bc9e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/13115c4c5fd7fbc58a0001d73646ee5a08f0bc9e.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]New Achievements[/h3]
It's no secret that you guys love secrets! That's why a couple of new Achievements will be added to the game as a reward to the most engaged players!

[h3]Language Support[/h3]
Finally, the update will also bring localization to three new languages: Spanish, French, and Italian. This will allow even more players from around the world to experience the beauty and wonder of Paradise Marsh in their own language, further expanding the game's community!

[h2]All in all, [/h2]
the upcoming content update promises to be a thrilling and enriching addition that gives even more reasons for old and new players to lose themselves in the contemplative and poetic world of Paradise Marsh.

Also, Tomorrow Paradise Marsh will be on sale for Steam Spring Sale!
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709170/Paradise_Marsh/]Perfect time to buy the game if you haven't yet![/url][/b]

notes.title: Paradise Marsh: Imminent Release!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you so much for your patience![/h1]

Hey y'all! Be sure to grab your bug nets because Paradise Marsh is coming out next week on Steam and consoles! Yes, after 2 long years of dedication, I'm finally done and ready to share this short and sweet little game with the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060767/be3b1557a62cc5a6a5a87ec7a7c4963a5996729f.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE DATE AND PRICING[/h1]
Mark your calendars, the game is coming out on [b]October 13th[/b]
The price is set to be 9.99$ USD or 8.19 euros (wow so cheap!)

[h1]PLATFORMS[/h1]
The game will come out on [b]PC[/b] (obviously), [b]Mac[/b], [b]Xbox Series/One[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]

Can't wait for the release? I get that I'm also very excited!
Until then join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/bnvNEHnWAr]Discord server[/url]
Or follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/LazyEti]Twitter [/url] for more news and cool content!
